title: Online AI Game Jam with ElevenLabs, Meshy.ai, and Nimble Fox ($7.5K+ in prizes)
author: puchi_mentos
selftext:
ElevenLabs, Meshy, and Nimble Fox are hosting the 2nd Nimble Game Jam on Oct 28 online and in San Fransisco. Everyone is welcomed to build on a new online platform, which turns prompts into playable Unity games in the browser.

**Prizes:**

* 1st: $1,000 + 3 months of ElevenLabs Pro and Meshy Premium + a guaranteed Chroma Awards semi-final spot
* 2nd: $500 · 3rd: $250
* Best Use of ElevenLabs and Best Use of Meshy awards
* Everyone: exclusive access to the new Nimble Fox platform + 1 month of ElevenLabs Creator and Meshy Pro

It’s free and you can join online from anywhere.   
Solo or in teams of up to 5.   
  
Building starts Wed Oct 28, 5 pm PT, and submissions close Fri Oct 30, 5 pm PT.

**Secure your spot here:** [https://luma.com/a5v21lfr](https://luma.com/a5v21lfr)
